theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_sheet_first_variation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ball p ρ ⊆ U → 1 ≤ k → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → T.support ∩ ball p ρ = M ∩ ball p ρ → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p ρ → HasMassDensity T y k) → ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ ball p ρ → R.firstVariation X = (k : ℝ) * ∫ x in M ∩ ball p ρ, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[n]
